# Strategies

[Previous: Whiteboard](./whiteboard.md) | [Workflow](./README.md) | [Next: Influence diagram](./influence_diagram.md)

Develop distinct courses of action by combining options across focus decisions. Review each strategy before comparing the selected combinations.

## Overview and navigation

### Open strategies

Select **Strategies** in the sidebar to review the strategy table and individual strategies.

![Strategies sidebar entry](<./figures/strategies/button - Strategies.png>)

### Develop strategies

Use the strategies page to define combinations of decision options and compare them in the strategy table.

![Strategies page](<./figures/strategies/page - Strategies.png>)

## Create a strategy

### Describe a new strategy

Enter a strategy name and rationale in the creation form.

![Empty strategy creation form](<./figures/strategies/field - Create strategy.png>)

### Choose a strategy icon

Select an icon to distinguish the strategy visually in the strategy table and cards.

![Strategy icon picker](<./figures/strategies/popup - Strategy icon.png>)

### Review a new strategy

The filled form illustrates a strategy to survey employees before committing to an event.

![Strategy creation form with example values](<./figures/strategies/field - Create strategy filled.png>)

### Create the strategy

Select **Create strategy** after completing the required details to add the strategy to the project.

![Create strategy button](<./figures/strategies/button - Create strategy.png>)

## Review choices and edit the strategy

### Review a strategy

An individual strategy shows its name, rationale, expected-value metrics, and options for focus decisions. Select an option card to include that choice; select it again to remove it. Use the rationale to explain why the combination is a coherent approach, rather than relying on the strategy name alone.

![Individual strategy and decision options](<./figures/strategies/card - Strategy.png>)

### Edit a strategy

Use the edit dialog to change the strategy's name, icon, color, or rationale, then select **Save**.

![Edit Strategy dialog](<./figures/strategies/window - Edit Strategy.png>)

## Compare strategies

### Include a strategy in the comparison

Toggle **Add to compare** to show or hide the strategy in the comparison table. This changes the comparison display, not the underlying decision problem or the uncertainty probabilities.

![Add to compare checkbox](<./figures/strategies/field - Add to compare.png>)

### Compare strategy choices

The strategy table shows which options each strategy selects across the project's focus decisions.

![Strategy table](<./figures/strategies/card - Strategy table.png>)

## Remove a strategy

Check the strategy named in the dialog before selecting **Delete**, or select **Cancel** to keep it.

![Delete Strategy confirmation dialog](<./figures/strategies/window - Delete Strategy.png>)
